An '''Imperial Intelligence Agent''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] and was stationed on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Poderis]].

==Biography==
When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived on the planet to [[Mission to Poderis|investigate]] a possible lead into [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] traffic, this agent was assigned to shadow Skywalker. The agent, however, failed to take into account Skywalker's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] abilities and was [[Force sense/Legends|detected]] almost immediately by Skywalker. Skywalker was subsequently able to escape the trap that the [[Thrawn's confederation|Imperials]] were laying for him.

Angered by the carelessness of the agent, Thrawn ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to log an order demoting the agent one grade in rank. Pellaeon reflected that this was a severe punishment, however the agent was quite lucky since the late [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lord Vader]] would have summarily [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|strangled]] the man.<ref name="LC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
